Spend management for modern finance teams

Ledgerly is a cloud subscription platform that helps finance teams at mid-market and enterprise B2B companies approve, track and control vendor spend in one place.

Built for enterprise procurement

Enterprise customers like Northwind Logistics use Ledgerly to route every purchase through approval workflows and security reviews before a vendor is onboarded.

We are preparing for our SOC 2 Type II audit, which is scheduled for the first quarter of 2027, after several enterprise prospects asked for the report.

Pricing

Plans start at $12 per user per month, with an Enterprise plan that adds SSO, audit logs and a dedicated success manager.

Ledgerly raised a $24M Series B led by Example Ventures to expand into enterprise accounts across Europe and North America.
